dct_creator_sm: Niver, William (Simon Fraser University). ORCID: https://orcid.org/0000-0001-8587-154X
dct_description_sm: This file contains weekly coal production data for the United States. For the period 1942-1976, the dataset includes total weekly production, number of working days, and average coal production per working day. For the period 1984-2023, the dataset separates weekly coal production by US region (Appalachian, Interior, Western). This data is associated with an article currently under review.
